{{Quote|Shadow Four, standing by.|Shadow Four|audio=ShadowFour-SoM.flac|<ref name="som" />}}
"'''Shadow Four'''" was the [[Callsign/Legends|call sign]] of a [[Clone trooper pilot/Legends|clone trooper pilot]] who served in [[Shadow Squadron/Legends|Shadow Squadron]], a [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] [[Squadron/Legends|unit]] in the [[Republic Navy/Legends|Navy]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. In the [[22 BBY/Legends|first year]] of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], Shadow Four and his squadron were sent on a mission to [[Battle of the Kaliida Nebula/Legends|destroy]] the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederate]] [[Warship/Legends|warship]] [[Malevolence/Legends|''Malevolence'']]. Led by [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]], Shadow Squadron [[Pilot/Legends|piloted]] [[BTL-B Y-wing starfighter/Legends|BTL-B Y-wing starfighters]] through the [[Kaliida Nebula/Legends|Kaliida Nebula]], where the pilots evaded gigantic [[Neebray/Legends|neebrays]]. Arriving at the [[Kaliida Shoals Medical Center/Legends|Kaliida Shoals Medical Center]], which the ''Malevolence'' had targeted, Shadow Four managed to avoid an ion ray launched by one of the [[Battleship/Legends|battleship's]] [[Ion cannon/Legends|ion cannons]]. Despite losses caused by the ion ray, the squadron continued its attack on the ''Malevolence'' and was eventually able to cripple its starboard ion cannon.

==Biography==
[[File:Battle_of_Kaliida.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Shadow Squadron attacks the ''Malevolence''.]]
The [[Clone trooper pilot/Legends|clone trooper pilot]] with [[Callsign/Legends|call sign]] "Shadow Four" served in the [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] [[Squadron/Legends|unit]] [[Shadow Squadron/Legends|Shadow Squadron]] of the [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].<ref name="som" /> A [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] of the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]], Shadow Four was born on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]].<ref name="db" /> In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]],<ref name="ERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]''</ref> after the [[Battle of Abregado/Legends|destruction]] of a [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] in the [[Abregado system/Legends|Abregado system]], the Republic learned about<ref name="rm">{{TCW|Rising Malevolence|Rising ''Malevolence''}}</ref> the [[Subjugator-class heavy cruiser/Legends|''Subjugator''-class heavy cruiser]]<ref name="tcwcg">''[[The Clone Wars Campaign Guide]]''</ref> [[Malevolence/Legends|''Malevolence'']]. The [[Warship/Legends|warship]], commanded by the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederate]] [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]], was armed with twin [[Ion cannon/Legends|ion cannons]] capable of disabling enemy [[Starship/Legends|ships]]. After the ''Malevolence'' [[Battle of the Ryndellia system/Legends|destroyed]] a medical convoy in the [[Ryndellia system/Legends|Ryndellia system]], [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] assumed that the [[Battleship/Legends|battleship]] was on its way to the [[Kaliida Shoals Medical Center/Legends|Kaliida Shoals Medical Center]], located near Ryndellia, and devised a plan to stop the [[Cruiser/Legends|cruiser]]. The [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]], together with his [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]] and [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Plo Koon/Legends|Plo Koon]], decided to lead Shadow Squadron, including Shadow Four, through a [[Balmorra Run/Legends|shortcut]] in the [[Kaliida Nebula/Legends|Kaliida Nebula]] in order to arrive to the [[Medcenter/Legends|medical center]] before the ''Malevolence''.<ref name="som" />

Departing from the [[Venator-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Venator''-class Star Destroyer]] [[Resolute/Legends|''Resolute'']] in [[BTL-B Y-wing starfighter/Legends|BTL-B Y-wing starfighters]], Skywalker contacted Shadow Four and the squadron, who checked in with the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] General. The squadron then jumped to [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] and eventually emerged at the Kaliida Nebula, where Skywalker led the [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]] into the [[Nebula/Legends|nebula]]. The squadron was caught by surprise upon noticing the [[Realspace/Legends|space]] [[Neebray/Legends|neebrays]] inhabiting the nebula, but all of the pilots managed to evade the massive creatures. As Shadow Four and his squadron piloted their [[Bomber/Legends|bombers]] out of the nebula, the ''Malevolence'' arrived from hyperspace. Shadow Squadron began their attack on the battleship, from which several [[Vulture-class starfighter/Legends|Vulture droids]] were launched. Grievous then ordered to fire the ion cannon toward the squadron, which was forced to take evasive actions. Shadow Four was one of the pilots that managed to avoid the ray, but a part of the squadron was left disabled in space. The remains of Shadow Squadron continued their attack on the ''Malevolence'', but upon facing heavy [[Laser/Legends|laser]] fire from the [[Turbolaser/Legends|turbolasers]] of the battleship, Tano and Koon advised Skywalker to abandon the original attack plan of targeting the [[Bridge (starship)/Legends|bridge]], where General Grievous was. Skywalker eventually agreed and ordered Shadow Four and the rest of the squadron to target the starboard ion cannon in order to prevent the ''Malevolence'' from launching its cannons on the medical center. Using [[Proton torpedo/Legends|proton torpedoes]], the Republic starfighters managed to cripple the cannon, preventing the destruction of the medical center.<ref name="som" />

==Personality and traits==
When the ''Malevolence'' launched an ion ray toward Shadow Squadron, Shadow Four was successfully able to evade the ray in time, while some of the pilots were struck by the ion ray, leaving them disabled in space.<ref name="som" />

==Behind the scenes==
The [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]] pilot using the call sign "Shadow Four" was first featured in "[[Shadow of Malevolence|Shadow of ''Malevolence'']]," the third episode of the [[The Clone Wars: Season One|first season]] of the ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' television series. Like all clone [[Trooper/Legends|troopers]] in the series, Shadow Four was voiced by [[Dee Bradley Baker]].<ref name="epguide">{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/guide/episode003.html|text=''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide: Shadow of ''Malevolence''}}</ref>
